sourceAccess.note: 抓取 1 次。含按日龄分工列表:Cell cleaning (days 1–2) / Nurse bees (days 3–12) / Queen attendants (days 7–11) / Wax production (days 13–18) / Guard bee (18–21) / Foraging bees (days 21–42);以及 worker jelly 与 royal jelly 同源腺体、21 天发育期。
抓取 1 次。含幼虫由哺育蜂喂养、约一周后封盖化蛹、再约一周出房;工蜂头 10 天清巢与喂幼虫;前 3 天喂蜂王浆后改喂花粉花蜜混合物。
抓取 1 次。含发育时间表(卵至第 3 天孵化、工蜂巢房约第 9 天封盖、第 21 天出房)、前 3 天喂蜂王浆后改喂花蜜/稀释蜂蜜与花粉、蜂王浆为年轻工蜂头部腺体分泌物。

issues.claim: spanText/span:哺育阶段为出房后第 3–12 天(第 23–33 天;span from 23 to 33)
issues.problem: 支持。Worker bee 分工列表原句:"Nurse bees (days 3–12)"。按本轮换算约定(出房 = 第 21 天,"出房后第 N 天"边界 = 21 + N),第 3 天起点 = 21 + 2 = 23,第 12 天终点 = 21 + 12 = 33,与 span {23, 33} 一致。附注:Western honey bee 给出另一种粗略说法 "For the first 10 days of their lives, worker bees clean the hive and feed the larvae",与 3–12 天不完全重合但并非否定,属不同来源的概括口径。
issues.evidence: Worker bee: "Nurse bees (days 3–12)";"After this 21 day developmental period, the adult bee will chew through its wax cap and cocoon and emerge into the hive as a fully grown bee."
issues.fix: 无需修改;若想兼容 Western honey bee 的口径,可在 spanText 前加"约"。

issues.claim: summary:哺育蜂用腺体分泌的乳状食物喂养工蜂幼虫(常称"工蜂浆",与蜂王浆来自同一类腺体)
issues.problem: 支持。Worker bee 明确写工蜂幼虫吃 worker jelly,且该分泌物来自产生 royal jelly 的腺体;Bee brood 写蜂王浆为年轻工蜂头部腺体分泌物。"常称"已作限定。
issues.evidence: Worker bee: "Nurse bees feed the worker larvae worker jelly, which is secreted from glands that produce royal jelly.";Bee brood: "worker bees add royal jelly - a secretion from glands on the heads of young bees."

issues.claim: summary:其中一部分(约出房后第 7–11 天)也会给蜂王喂食、梳理体表
issues.problem: 支持。Worker bee 分工列表 "Queen attendants (days 7–11)",职责为喂食与梳理蜂王;数字一致且已用"约"限定。
issues.evidence: Worker bee: "Queen attendants (days 7–11)";"Queen attendants take care of the queen by feeding and grooming her."

issues.claim: detail:哺育蜂喂养幼虫约 6 天
issues.problem: 支持(已限定"约")。Bee brood 时间表:卵至第 3 天孵化、工蜂巢房至第 9 天封盖,即幼虫开放喂养期约 6 天;Western honey bee 亦称约一周后封盖。
issues.evidence: Bee brood 发育表:eggs "until day 3"、cell capping "until day 9";Western honey bee: "After about a week, the larva is sealed in its cell by the nurse bees and begins its pupal stage."

issues.claim: detail:约第 9 天巢房被封上蜡盖,幼虫在里面化蛹
issues.problem: 支持。Bee brood 时间表工蜂封盖在第 9 天;Western honey bee 写封盖后进入蛹期;Worker bee 写成蜂咬破蜡盖出房,证明盖为蜡质。
issues.evidence: Bee brood: cell capping "until day 9"、emergence "from day 21 on";Western honey bee: "the larva is sealed in its cell by the nurse bees and begins its pupal stage. After another week, it emerges as an adult bee.";Worker bee: "the adult bee will chew through its wax cap and cocoon"。
